what.a: An interview-prep workspace: resumes and cover letters, job discovery and tracking, multi-format practice, and a readiness signal so you always know the next high-leverage step.

free.a: You can start on a free plan with credits. Some AI and collab actions may use credits; top-up is available when billing is configured.

practice.a: Simulations include code-run, workspace, conversation tracks, and more. Some formats are still rolling out depending on environment.

docs.q: Where can I learn the product?
docs.a: Open the public docs site for task-first how-tos, or use in-app Ask after you sign in.

data.a: Your account owns your materials. Collab share links stay active while the owner is in the document, with view or edit roles.
